Real compile+run+assert proof (sum-to-n, self-compiled, correct 0/6/15). Fixed a live-found get-field-on-nested-expr bug and a bogus recur() call emission. is-valid-i32-text?/split still don't fully self-compile (real, separate, named gaps), split's own loop bindings now correctly emit though. make test: 347/347. Apple #18720. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
